parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small plastic component located on the top of the toilet tank, used to activate the flushing mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It triggers the flush valve to release water from the tank into the bowl for cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a flat plastic cover placed on top of the toilet tank to conceal internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the tank interior from dust and provides a finished appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically removable but does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main ceramic structure of the toilet, including the bowl and pedestal.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user’s weight, holds water, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor.
